newsitem.title: USA: Unocal says restarted Calif. hydrogen unit.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says restarted Calif. hydrogen unit.

text.p: Unocal Corp said on Monday it restarted a hydrogen production unit at its Rodeo, Calif., refinery after completing 10 days of planned maintenance.
The unit, with a capacity of 24 million standard cubic feet per day (MMSCFD), was shut September 20 and restarted Sunday, according to the company.
"It did not have an affect on our production," Michelle Simms, a refinery spokeswoman, told Reuters.
The outage may have started rumors of a refinery problem on Friday, which lifted gasoline prices in San Francisco by about 1.50 cents Friday.
